title: Simple Chickens
description: Retextures the 1.21.5 chicken variants to be the temperate version.
body:
Do you find Minecraft’s chickens too varied for your liking? The “Simple Chickens” resource pack has you covered!
- This simple pack retextures all 1.21.5 chickens variants to match the temperate variant, creating a consistent look across your world. Their eggs are also retextured to match, ensuring a unified aesthetic.
  
- To avoid confusion when stacking eggs in your inventory, their original names remain unchanged.
  
- Perfect for players who want a cleaner, more consistent appearance without altering gameplay balance.
